dashboard.name: C - Capacité & Occupation
dashboard.description: Capacité par service, lits occupés, taux d'occupation, et séries temporelles détaillées.

cards.name: Tendance - Capacité totale
cards.query: SELECT day, capacity_total FROM vw_kpi_daily ORDER BY day;

cards.name: Tendance - Taux d'occupation (global)
cards.query: SELECT day, occupancy_rate FROM vw_kpi_daily ORDER BY day;

cards.name: Occupation horaire par service (dernier 7 jours)
cards.query: SELECT date, hour, service_name, occupied_beds, beds_total, occupancy_rate FROM vw_occupancy_timeseries WHERE date >= (current_date - INTERVAL '7 days') ORDER BY date, hour;
cards.notes: Utiliser heatmap ou barres empilées selon préférence UI

cards.name: Capacité par service (dernier jour)
cards.query: SELECT service_name, beds_total, occupied_beds, occupancy_rate FROM vw_service_summary WHERE date = (SELECT MAX(day) FROM vw_kpi_daily) ORDER BY occupancy_rate DESC;

cards.name: Services avec taux d'occupation élevé
cards.query: SELECT service_name, occupancy_rate FROM vw_service_summary WHERE date = (SELECT MAX(day) FROM vw_kpi_daily) AND occupancy_rate IS NOT NULL ORDER BY occupancy_rate DESC LIMIT 10;
